skills.name: Shadowchaser (逐影)
skills.line: Mt. Suzuka is where we truly belong.
skills.description: Suzuka Gozen uses her white hot Shadowchaser to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Mountain's Soul: Ultra (麓魂・极)
skills.line: No one will be left behind this time.
skills.description: Suzuka Gozen wields her Nether Bow to attack 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 211% of her ATK and gains Obligated Duty until her next turn. ; : ;Obligated Duty (義の心) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Exclusive effect. Creates a shield that can absorb 115% of her ATK, cannot be dispelled. While the shield is active, enemies cannot target Suzuka Gozen's allies. The shield can can take up to 5 attacks. When the shield is destroyed, this effect is removed. ;Mountain's Barrier (麓障) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Damage received is reduced by 60% (cannot exceed 40% of her ATK). This effect is removed upon receiving a single attack. ;Crit RES :Source of damage has its Crit reduced.

upgrades.text: After using this skill, the move bar for all allies is increased by 10%.
As long as she has Obligated Duty, her RES increased by 50%.
As long as she has Obligated Duty, her Crit RES increased by 200%.
When she gains Obligated Duty and if the targeted enemy is not immobile, they are forced to gain a new turn and launch a normal attack at Suzuka Gozen (monsters or summonable enemies are unaffected).

skills.name: Crashing Barrage (万羽浪行)
skills.line: Don't you dare belittle Mt. Suzuka.
skills.description: Suzuka Gozen combines the power of her two weapons and shoots Shadowchaser with her Nether Bow to launch a 5-strike attack on all enemies, dealing damage equal to 44% of her ATK with each strike and also inflicts 10% of HP Steal.

upgrades.text: Each onibi spent by an ally increases her own ATK and DEF by 2% (max 50 stack).

bio.condition: Team Suzuka Gozen with another player's Ootakemaru and clear any zone 10 times.
With Suzuka Gozen win 30 times in PVP, Practice or Spar.
